info.title: ANSTAY Integration Gateway
info.description: Server-to-server contract for ANSTAY website, channel manager and OTA adapters. Availability honors confirmed bookings, owner/maintenance blocks and active temporary holds. Rates are returned only after explicit publication. Outbound OTA changes are queued in a durable database outbox until a channel adapter acknowledges delivery.

get.summary: Active villas, booking policies, channels, rate plans and mappings
Physical stay availability including booking, block and hold conflicts
Daily inventory, published rate and restrictions up to 93 days
Search all active villas for a stay, guest count, channel and rate plan
Quote a sellable stay and calculate guest surcharges when rules are explicit

post.summary: Create a 5–20 minute temporary website hold after rechecking availability and price
Create idempotent external reservation; optional hold_token is validated and converted

patch.summary: Update external reservation with capacity and block checks

post.summary: Cancel external reservation by channel + external_reservation_id

get.summary: Pull pending outbound OTA inventory events with current channel mapping

patch.summary: Acknowledge an outbox event as sent, failed or pending
